properties.Name: San Fernando de Henares Industrial Park
properties.Description: – 60 000 m² campus with up to 79 MW planned (130 MVA) – Direct access to Barcelona–Madrid fiber highway – 10 min from Adolfo Suárez Barajas Airport – Multiple 220–400 kV substations on‑site
properties.Reference: Iron Mountain MAD‑1 (“C. del Mar Egeo, 4, 28830 San Fernando de Henares”) (Iron Mountain)

properties.Name: Alcobendas – Equinix MD2
properties.Description: – 4 000 m² facility (expandable) with 3 MW live load today and room for 79 MW – Situated in a major tech park with extensive fiber rings – Zoned for heavy‑industrial / data‑use – Low flood/seismic risk
properties.Reference: Equinix MD2, Calle Valgrande 6, 28108 Alcobendas (Data Centers)

properties.Name: Las Rozas de Madrid – NTT Madrid 1
properties.Description: – 3 400 m² server space with 6.9 MW IT load – 2N UPS, N+1 generator redundancy – Proximity to 400 kV Aquisgrán substation – Easy highway access (M‑503/M‑505) – Industrial zoning, low flood footprint
properties.Reference: NTT Madrid 1 Data Center, Calle Aquisgrán 2, Las Rozas de Madrid (NTT)

properties.Name: Alcalá de Henares – Punto Com Park
properties.Description: – Located in established industrial/manufacturing zone – Served by 220 kV Almudena substation nearby – Direct rail corridor to Madrid for dark‑fiber routes – Municipally designated for “high‑tech / logistics” uses
properties.Reference: Nabiax Alcalá Data Center (“Av. Punto Com 23, 28805 Alcalá de Henares”) (Data Centers)

properties.Name: Valdebebas – New Urban Extension
properties.Description: – Large undeveloped parcels adjacent to new 400 kV Valdebebas substation – Fiber ring backbone for Metro‑Ethernet in build – Zoned as “Innovation District” with streamlined permitting – Outside known 100‑yr flood zones
properties.Reference: No single public dataset—combine ENTSO‑E grid map + Madrid land‑use plan for substation proximity and zoning requirements
